description: MITRE adversary emulation plan inspired by FIN6 (G0037). The technique sequence draws from the ATT&CK G0037 group page and the MITRE Center for Threat-Informed Defense FIN6 emulation library (https://github.com/center-for-threat-informed-defense/adversary_emulation_library/tree/master/fin6). FIN6 is Windows-centric: techniques with a Linux ART executor are dispatched caldera_driven (faithful to the canonical MITRE ability); Windows-native techniques are recorded as inspired markers on the Linux substrate, with the substrate gap honestly preserved in the manifest. This is the right shape for a paper claim about 'real adversary emulation backed by MITRE Caldera': we run what MITRE actually ships, and we declare what we can't.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.description: FIN6 has gained initial access via internet-exposed apps. No Linux ART ability ships in stock Caldera for the generic T1190.

techniques.name: External Remote Services
techniques.description: FIN6 leverages exposed remote services. No stock Linux ART ability.

techniques.name: Unix Shell
techniques.description: S25 honest limitation: Caldera's stock T1059.004 ability is the sandcat self-installer (`nohup ./sandcat.go -server...`) which is not applicable to FIN6's tradecraft and not portable. Recorded as inspired marker rather than a faked caldera_driven success.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: FIN6 reuses harvested credentials. Lab pre-stages credentials but the technique itself has no ART ability.

techniques.name: File and Directory Discovery
techniques.description: Filesystem enumeration. Caldera ships 'List Directory' as a clean Linux ART ability.

techniques.name: Local Account Discovery
techniques.description: Enumerate local accounts. Caldera ships 'Find local users' Linux ART ability.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
techniques.description: LSASS is Windows-only — no Linux equivalent. FIN6 dumps it via procdump. Recorded as inspired on the Linux substrate.

techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
techniques.description: FIN6 has brute-forced credentials. No stock ART ability matches this technique on Linux without fact configuration.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
techniques.description: HTTP(S) C2. Caldera carries 'Ragdoll' as a Linux ART ability for this technique.

techniques.name: Encrypted Channel
techniques.description: FIN6 wraps C2 in TLS. Encryption is implicit in the sandcat-to-Caldera channel but no dedicated ART ability.

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
techniques.description: FIN6 has deployed ransomware (Ryuk, LockerGoga). Lab does not execute destructive techniques; inspired marker only.

techniques.name: Inhibit System Recovery
techniques.description: FIN6 disables backup/restore (vssadmin). Windows-specific. Recorded inspired.
